pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold light, main subject in the middle of the frame. No text, letters or writing of any script (no Gurmukhi), no logos or modern objects. Gentle and peaceful, no violence, no injury.
